product_one_liner.value: Druid AI helps enterprises build and deploy AI agents that automate customer and employee workflows across chat, voice, SMS, and email while integrating with existing business systems.
product_one_liner.notes: The company-issued announcement describes enterprise AI agents that automate customer and employee journeys across chat, SMS, voice, and email and integrate with existing enterprise systems: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261014498211/en/Druid-AI-Expands-Enterprise-Agentic-AI-Platform-with-Voice-Enhancements-Agent-Interoperability-and-Governance-Capabilities

pricing_page.notes: The public pricing page describes tailored pricing plans and a pricing model based on use case and deployment requirements. Public dollar prices are not required by the question: https://www.druidai.com/pricing

founded_year.notes: The company’s about page explicitly states that Druid was founded in 2018: https://www.druidai.com/about-us

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index emphasizes enterprise use cases, best practices, and deployment strategies and shows one reference-model article, without establishing two engineer-authored posts about how Druid is built. This meets the specified negative criterion: https://www.druidai.com/blog/all

public_docs.notes: The public documentation portal links to multiple guides, including Druid Voice, Synonyms Dictionary, and HigherEd Agentic Advisor, establishing more than a single FAQ: https://docs.druidai.com/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live official job board lists Technical Consultant as its current opening and no qualifying AI, ML, or data-science title. The separate sales listing does not qualify as an AI/ML role: https://druidsa.bamboohr.com/careers

model_provider.value: Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Druid’s proprietary Becus private LLM are publicly named configurable models/providers.
model_provider.notes: The AI-agents product page explicitly names Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Druid’s private LLM Becus. It identifies Becus as proprietary and intended for air-gapped or on-premises deployments; no universal default model is claimed: https://www.druidai.com/platform/druid-ai-agents
